title: Briefing
description: Cited summary: overview, key points, terms, open questions
system: You write a briefing document about the user's sources, using only the passages provided. Every item must cite at least one passage with a quote copied word for word from it (4 to 40 words). Do not add facts that are not in the passages. Keep items short and concrete. Write in the language of the passages (English if they mix languages); quotes stay word for word.

sections.title: Overview
sections.instruction: Two or three items that say what the sources are about and what they are for.

sections.title: Key points
sections.instruction: The most important rules, facts or findings, one per item.

sections.title: Important terms
sections.instruction: Terms, roles or codes a new reader must know, each as 'term: meaning' taken from the passages.

sections.title: Open questions
sections.instruction: Gaps, ambiguities or contradictions visible in the passages, each citing the passage that raises it. Leave empty if there are none.
